iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 42. BREAKING: US-Iran 2-week ceasefire agreed Apr 7-8 (11th hour deal). Iran 10-point plan accepted as 'workable basis' by Trump. Strait of Hormuz reopening. HOWEVER: Ceasefire is only 2 weeks, fragile. Netanyahu says deal 'does not include Lebanon'. Enrichment continues ~60%. Bushehr struck Apr 4-5. IAEA still withdrawn. Technical risk unchanged. Ceasefire reduces immediate escalation but nuclear program continues. Diplomatic: MEDIUM (up from LOW). Rhetoric: MEDIUM (down from HIGH). Mobilization: MEDIUM (down from HIGH).

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 42. BREAKING: 2-week ceasefire agreed Apr 7-8. Iran to allow safe passage through Hormuz. Trump pulled back from 'destroy every power plant' threat. HOWEVER: Israel continues heaviest strikes on Lebanon (not covered by ceasefire). Strait reopening conditional on coordination. Fragile ceasefire - only 2 weeks. Iran still hit Jebel Ali (UAE). Cyber warfare ongoing. Diplomatic: MEDIUM (up from LOW). Rhetoric: MEDIUM (down from HIGH).

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: CRITICAL: Israel carried out HEAVIEST strikes on Lebanon since conflict began Apr 8, even as Hezbollah paused attacks under US-Iran ceasefire framework. Netanyahu explicitly stated ceasefire 'does not include Lebanon'. Israel expanding ground invasion, reissued sweeping evacuation orders for southern Lebanon. Lebanese President Aoun condemned attacks as 'barbaric'. Arab League accused Israel of 'seeking to sabotage' ceasefire. 400+ Hezbollah fighters killed. 1.2M displaced. Probability UP to 45% - Israel exploiting Iran ceasefire to escalate Lebanon front.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: No significant changes. Strategic ambiguity maintained. FM Fidan's nuclear rhetoric unchanged. OSW analysis: Turkey playing strategic ambiguity game - refraining from explicit declarations while outlining red lines. Akkuyu NPP commissioning on track. NATO B61-12 at Incirlik. Roketsan 300 ER missile test planned 2026. No new escalation signals.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: CFR 'Conflicts to Watch 2026' report: moderate likelihood of India-Pakistan conflict due to Kashmir terrorism. Carnegie analysis: 'nuclear noise and signalling' in India-Pakistan crises. Kashmir speakers warn 'nuclear flashpoint'. No new tactical escalation. Nuclear facility lists exchanged Jan 1 2026 (confidence-building). Slight uptick from 15.5 to 16.0 reflecting sustained risk.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: New START expired Feb 4 2026 - NO replacement treaty. Le Monde: 'dangerous signal for deterrence'. SIPRI: 'new phase of heightened nuclear dangers'. Bulletin: 136+ Russian nuclear signaling incidents tracked since Ukraine invasion. Russia standing with Iran (warned US-Israel on nuclear targeting). Ongoing 'dirty bomb' disinformation against Ukraine. No bilateral arms control in sight. Stable at 60% - structural risk unchanged.

china.name: China
china.notes: CNN INVESTIGATION Apr 1 2026: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure. Testing new generation nuclear warheads. Massive surge in missile production sites revealed by satellite. HOWEVER: Taiwan Strait stable. KMT delegation visiting China. US intel maintains 2027 invasion unlikely. Taiwan budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons. ISW/AEI Apr 3: No significant PLA activity changes. Technical: HIGH (up from MEDIUM) due to infrastructure expansion. Rising to 10% reflecting long-term buildup.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: ESCALATING: Multiple ballistic missiles fired Apr 7-8 (2nd launch in 2 days). Kim Jong Un declared nuclear status 'irreversible' - constitutional mandate. Solid-fuel engine test for ICBM capable of targeting US mainland (Mar 29). KN-14 solid ICBM operational. Submarine missile test IMMINENT (maintenance complete). Kim observed 600mm rocket tests with daughter. Kim demands US nuclear recognition as precondition. INDOPCOM confirmed Apr 7-8 launches. Rhetoric: CRITICAL (up from HIGH). Probability UP to 85%.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. ISW Offensive Campaign Assessments daily through Apr 5. Russia concocting fresh 'Ukrainian bomb' claims (Arms Control Association Apr 2026) - potential pretext for nuclear escalation. GCRI: nuclear escalation risk elevated if Russia perceives failure. Russia preparing Oreshnik systems. Drone/missile strikes continue. Hybrid warfare intensifying. Arms Control: Ukrainian denial of 'dirty bomb' claims. Stable-to-rising at 83%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: China-brokered peace talks underway in Urumqi (Apr 1-3). Pakistan confirmed new round of talks. TTP announced 3-day ceasefire for Eid al-Fitr. Fighting resumed at lower intensity. UN experts called for lasting peace. China 'actively mediating' (FM Mao Ning). Diplomatic track holding - slight de-escalation. Diplomatic: MEDIUM (up from LOW). Rhetoric: MEDIUM (down from HIGH). Mobilization: MEDIUM (down from HIGH). Probability DOWN to 15%.
